text.description_html:
Acorn AIKBQ, Smooth Iron Heart Tip Offset Cabinet Strap Hinge

The 6-1/2" Smooth Iron Cabinet Heart Tip Offset Strap Hinge is suitable for lightweight doors or cabinets. It is for use on doors whose face sits 3/8" out from the door frame. Its old world charm is in both the heart tip design and in the smooth iron finish which is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it may have looked originally if it was forged a century ago. Available in both a flush and an offset variety. The Smooth Iron Cabinet Heart Tip Strap Hinge has a lifetime no rust warranty. Click Here to see the entire Acorn Heart Tip Collection

Also Available: Flush Smooth Iron Cabinet Heart Tip Strap Hinge

Specifications for the Acorn Heart Tip Cabinet Strap Hinge:

  • For doors whose face sits 3/8" out from the door frame.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Packaged with black finish mounting screws.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Specifications of the 6-1/2" Cabinet Strap Hinge:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Material: Iron
  • Length: 6-1/2"
  • Width: 1-3/4"
  • Offset: 3/8"

Sold as a pair (2-hinges).
